content:
maria: Quick check — we're scheduled to start the model-v9 canary tomorrow. Want to lock slices and run a rollback drill beforehand. Flag name is feature/model_v9_canary. Who's owning the percent ramp and regional split?

ajay: I'll take percent schedule. Proposal: 1% -> 5% -> 20% over ~3 hours. Regions: NA first, then EU, then APAC. Add a pinned internal slice for QA. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

sam: Prefer we do NA+EU at 1% initially to catch region infra+latency diffs. Also create an "internal-qc" traffic slice (internal accounts only) pinned to 100% so product/QA can hammer it. Critical: emergency kill switch and a short runbook for oncall.

tess: @oncall-bot can you post the drill checklist + emergency cutoff command here?

oncall-bot: Drill checklist attached: 1) Reserve rollout window in calendar (2h) 2) Deploy feature flag config to canary channel 3) Start at 1% traffic, monitor p95 latency, error rate, hallucination signal, and token cost 4) If threshold crossed, run emergency cutoff. Emergency cutoff command (console + cli):
```
# CLI quick cutoff
rbctl flags set feature/model_v9_canary false --now
# Console: Feature Flags > feature/model_v9_canary > Disable Immediately
```
Make sure paging is enabled for model_v9_latency_alert and model_v9_errors_alert.

maria: Adding the internal-qc slice now. Ajay, can you update rollout config in the console and add the schedule? I'll handle the calendar/reservation.

ajay: On it — pushing schedule and slice config. Sample rollout config I pushed to infra (sanitized):
```json
{
  "flag": "feature/model_v9_canary",
  "slices": [
    {"name": "internal-qc", "audience": "internal_only", "percent": 0},
    {"name": "canary_slice", "audience": "all", "percent": 1}
  ],
  "schedule": [
    {"time": "2026-03-18T10:00:00-07:00", "percent": 1, "regions": ["na","eu"]},
    {"time": "2026-03-18T10:30:00-07:00", "percent": 5, "regions": ["na","eu"]},
    {"time": "2026-03-18T11:30:00-07:00", "percent": 20, "regions": ["na"]},
    {"time": "2026-03-18T12:00:00-07:00", "percent": 20, "regions": ["na","eu","apac"]}
  ]
}
```

sam: Add an automated rollback rule: if latency_p95 > 1.5s OR error_rate > 0.5% for 5m, auto-disable the flag and page oncall. Also set a short cooldown so we don't flipflop. And set cache_prefix to avoid stale KV interfering: cache_prefix: "v9_test_"

tess: Can someone run a staging dry-run and confirm KV warmup behavior? I'll do a staged run at 09:30 PT and report back.

maria: Timeline for folks to see: 10:00 PT start at 1% for NA+EU, 10:30 -> 5%, 11:30 -> 20% (NA), 12:00 add APAC at 1% then ramp. Rollback window is 2 hours after start. Ping this thread when live and when each step completes.

ajay: Config pushed to infra/feature-flags. CLI command I used: `rbctl rollout create --flag feature/model_v9_canary --from-config /infra/rollouts/model_v9.json` — will watch dashboards.

sam: Reminder: for initial slices set cache TTL=0 for keys so the perf signals reflect cold-start perf. Otherwise KV cache will mask regressions.

oncall-bot: Alerts created: model_v9_latency_alert, model_v9_errors_alert. Paging enabled for #eng-oncall. Automated rollback rule hooked to flag.

tess: Staging run complete. KV warmup looks fine, small p95 bump ~120ms for first 5k calls then stabilizes. I'll attach rough numbers in ticket.

maria: Good. If any quality regressions detected, we fallback to model-v8 by toggling `feature/model_v9_canary=false` and leave the rollout config untouched (so we can re-run). Please do not change flag name or slice ids during the drill. Ticket with runbook and links: LINK_TO_TICKET (internal).

ajay: :thumbsup: monitoring dashboards and logs. Will post live updates at each percent step.

sam: LGTM from model-side. Make sure eval set runs during the 1% window so we get quick quality metrics.

maria: Thanks everyone — I'll update calendar invite and post final go/no-go in this thread 30m before start.
